# EIM Lab Website — Enterprise Infrastructure Management (EIM) Laboratory

> Official website of the Enterprise Infrastructure Management (EIM) Laboratory, Telkom University.

## Project Overview
- **Project Name:** EIM Lab Website
- **Organization:** Enterprise Infrastructure Management (EIM) Laboratory, Telkom University
- **Repository:** https://github.com/LABEIM/LAB-EIM
- **Production URL:** https://eimlab.org/
- **Documentation:** https://github.com/LABEIM/LAB-EIM#readme
- **Maintainer Contact:** lab@eimlab.org

## Tech Stack & Architecture
- **Framework:** Astro v7.1.6 (static site generation) with React 19 islands
- **Content:** Keystatic CMS with Markdown collections and JSON data files (no database)
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS v4.3.3 with modular vanilla CSS
- **Deployment:** Cloudflare Workers (primary), Vercel (prerendered static backup)
- **CI/CD:** LABEIM Shared CI/CD Workflow (`.github/workflows/ci-cd.yml`)

## Key Endpoints & Routes
- `/` : Home page
- `/about` : Laboratory profile and history
- `/assets` : Brand and email asset hub
- `/contact` : Contact information
- `/structure` : Laboratory role hierarchy (lecturers, assistants, student members, adhoc roles) and staff profiles
- `/courses` : Courses in the lab's field of study with code and SKS
- `/courses/<slug>` : One course: description, practicum modules, coordinator, and assistants
- `/news`, `/news/[id]` : News listing and article detail
- `/event`, `/event/[id]` : Event listing and detail
- `/registration` : Recruitment registration form
- `/api/save-recruitment-results` : Persists recruitment results
